example.hanzi: 你昨天為什麼沒來上課？
example.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān wèishénme méi lái shàngkè?
example.gloss: Why didn't you come to class yesterday?

example.hanzi: 我先去買飲料，你在這裡坐一下。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiān qù mǎi yǐnliào, nǐ zài zhèlǐ zuò yíxià.
example.gloss: I'll go buy drinks first; you sit here a moment.

vocab.gloss: to appear; to arise; to emerge
to understand; to realize; to find out

example.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài liǎojiě nǐ de yìsi.
example.gloss: I don't quite understand what you mean.

example.hanzi: 過去我常常騎腳踏車上班。
example.pinyin: Guòqù wǒ chángcháng qí jiǎotàchē shàngbān.
example.gloss: In the past I often rode a bike to work.

grammar.title: 先……再…… (first… then…)
grammar.explanation: 用「先」說第一件事，用「再」說下一件事。「先」放在動詞前面，不放在句子最前面的主語前。也可以說「我們先……，等一下再……」。

examples.hanzi: 我們先吃飯，再去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chīfàn, zài qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.gloss: Let's eat first, then go see a movie.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān xǐshǒu, zài chī dōngxi.
examples.gloss: Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiān qù yóujú, zài qù yínháng.
examples.gloss: I'll go to the post office first, then the bank.

grammar.title: 為什麼 (why)
grammar.explanation: 「為什麼」問原因，放在動詞前面。回答時常用「因為……」。

examples.gloss: Why hasn't he shown up yet?

examples.hanzi: 因為下雨，所以我搭捷運。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dā jiéyùn.
examples.gloss: Because it's raining, I take the MRT.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 小雨，老闆為什麼還沒出現？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Yǔ, lǎobǎn wèishénme hái méi chūxiàn?
dialogue.gloss: Xiao Yu, why hasn't the boss shown up yet?

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 他說他先去郵局，晚一點才會到。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā shuō tā xiān qù yóujú, wǎn yìdiǎn cái huì dào.
dialogue.gloss: He said he's going to the post office first and will arrive a bit later.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 沒關係，我們先去旁邊喝杯咖啡吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒmen xiān qù pángbiān hē bēi kāfēi ba.
dialogue.gloss: No problem, let's go next door for a cup of coffee first.

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊，過去我常常來這家店。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, guòqù wǒ chángcháng lái zhè jiā diàn.
dialogue.gloss: Sure, I used to come to this shop a lot.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 現在我了解你為什麼喜歡這裡了，很安靜。
dialogue.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ liǎojiě nǐ wèishénme xǐhuān zhèlǐ le, hěn ānjìng.
dialogue.gloss: Now I understand why you like it here — it's very quiet.

dialogue.speaker: 小雨
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊，坐在這裡很舒服喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, zuò zài zhèlǐ hěn shūfú o.
dialogue.gloss: Right, sitting here feels really comfortable.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān dā jiéyùn guòqù ba.
sentences.gloss: Let's take the MRT over there first.
It's fine, take your time and speak slowly.
The boss hasn't shown up yet.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài liǎojiě nǐ de yìsi le.
sentences.gloss: Now I understand what you mean.

vocab.gloss: to participate; to take part; to join

example.hanzi: 我想參加這個籃球比賽。
example.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng cān jiā zhè ge lán qiú bǐ sài.
example.gloss: I want to take part in this basketball game.

example.pinyin: nǐ qù guò jǐ ge guó jiā?
example.gloss: How many countries have you been to?

vocab.gloss: to decide (to do something); to resolve; decision

example.pinyin: wǒ jué dìng zhōu mò qù kàn diàn yǐng.
example.gloss: I've decided to go see a movie this weekend.

vocab.gloss: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to allocate; to distinguish (good and bad)

example.pinyin: lǎo bǎn bǎ qián fēn gěi sān ge rén.
example.gloss: The boss divided the money among three people.

example.hanzi: 這家店的東西很多，選擇也很多。
example.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xi hěn duō, xuǎn zé yě hěn duō.
example.gloss: This shop has a lot of stuff, so there are many choices.

example.hanzi: 我們可以搭捷運或者騎腳踏車。
example.pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ dā jié yùn huò zhě qí jiǎo tà chē.
example.gloss: We can take the MRT or ride bicycles.

grammar.title: Using 或者 to say "or" in statements
grammar.explanation: 或者 means "or" and is used in statements to give two possible choices. In questions where you ask someone to pick one, Taiwanese Mandarin uses 還是 instead. So: 你要喝茶還是咖啡？(question) but 我想喝茶或者咖啡。(statement).

examples.hanzi: 你可以喝茶或者喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ hē chá huò zhě hē kā fēi.
examples.gloss: You can drink tea or coffee.

examples.hanzi: 我週末想看電影或者逛夜市。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhōu mò xiǎng kàn diàn yǐng huò zhě guàng yè shì.
examples.gloss: This weekend I want to see a movie or go to the night market.

examples.hanzi: 我還沒決定要參加籃球賽或者游泳比賽。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hái méi jué dìng yào cān jiā lán qiú sài huò zhě yóu yǒng bǐ sài.
examples.gloss: I haven't decided whether to join the basketball game or the swimming competition.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 週末你有時間嗎？我想參加路跑比賽。
dialogue.pinyin: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu shí jiān ma? wǒ xiǎng cān jiā lù pǎo bǐ sài.
dialogue.gloss: Do you have time this weekend? I want to join the road race.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 有啊，可是我還沒決定要參加路跑或者游泳。
dialogue.pinyin: yǒu a, kě shì wǒ hái méi jué dìng yào cān jiā lù pǎo huò zhě yóu yǒng.
dialogue.gloss: Yes, but I haven't decided whether to do the road race or swimming.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 你選擇路跑吧，我們可以一起跑。
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ xuǎn zé lù pǎo ba, wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ pǎo.
dialogue.gloss: Choose the road race, then we can run together.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊！那我們怎麼去？搭捷運嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo a! nà wǒ men zěn me qù? dā jié yùn ma?
dialogue.gloss: OK! So how do we get there? By MRT?

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 搭捷運或者騎腳踏車都可以。
dialogue.pinyin: dā jié yùn huò zhě qí jiǎo tà chē dōu kě yǐ.
dialogue.gloss: MRT or bicycle, both are fine.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 那我決定搭捷運，捷運更快。以後我還想去別的國家參加比賽喔！
dialogue.pinyin: nà wǒ jué dìng dā jié yùn, jié yùn gèng kuài. yǐ hòu wǒ hái xiǎng qù bié de guó jiā cān jiā bǐ sài o!
dialogue.gloss: Then I've decided on the MRT, it's faster. In the future I also want to go to other countries to compete!

sentences.pinyin: wǒ jué dìng cān jiā zhè ge bǐ sài.
sentences.gloss: I've decided to take part in this competition.

sentences.pinyin: nǐ qù guò jǐ ge guó jiā?
sentences.gloss: How many countries have you been to?

sentences.pinyin: wǒ men dā jié yùn huò zhě qí jiǎo tà chē qù.
sentences.gloss: We'll go by MRT or by bicycle.

sentences.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de xuǎn zé hěn duō.
sentences.gloss: This shop has a lot of choices.

sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn bǎ qián fēn gěi dà jiā.
sentences.gloss: The boss divided the money among everyone.

example.hanzi: 這個機會很好,你要去試試看。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge jīhuì hěn hǎo, nǐ yào qù shìshi kàn.
example.gloss: This is a great opportunity; you should give it a try.

example.pinyin: Biéren de dōngxi bù kěyǐ ná.
example.gloss: You can't take other people's things.

vocab.gloss: to make; to cause; to enable

example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ hěn lèi.
example.gloss: This matter makes me very tired.

example.pinyin: Qíshí wǒ bú tài xiǎng qù.
example.gloss: Actually, I don't really want to go.

example.hanzi: 以後有機會再來我家玩。
example.pinyin: Yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì zài lái wǒ jiā wán.
example.gloss: Come over to my place again sometime later when you get the chance.

example.hanzi: 老闆要求我們八點到公司。
example.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yāoqiú wǒmen bā diǎn dào gōngsī.
example.gloss: The boss requires us to be at the company by eight.

grammar.title: A 使 B + 感覺/形容詞 (A makes B feel ...)
grammar.pattern: A + 使 + 人 + 感覺/形容詞
grammar.explanation: 使 means "to make; to cause". The thing that causes the feeling goes first, then 使, then the person, then how that person feels or becomes. 使 is a little more formal than 讓, and is common in writing and in polite spoken Mandarin.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ hěn kāixīn.

examples.hanzi: 這個機會使他更有信心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jīhuì shǐ tā gèng yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.gloss: This opportunity makes him more confident.

dialogue.speaker: 小方
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn lèi.
dialogue.gloss: What's up with you? You look really tired.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 老闆要求我們週末也要上班。
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yāoqiú wǒmen zhōumò yě yào shàngbān.
dialogue.gloss: The boss requires us to work on weekends too.

dialogue.speaker: 小方
dialogue.hanzi: 其實你可以跟他說你有事。
dialogue.pinyin: Qíshí nǐ kěyǐ gēn tā shuō nǐ yǒu shì.
dialogue.gloss: Actually, you could tell him you have something on.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 我知道,可是這個機會很好,別人也很想要。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, kěshì zhè ge jīhuì hěn hǎo, biéren yě hěn xiǎng yào.
dialogue.gloss: I know, but this is a good opportunity, and others want it too.

dialogue.speaker: 小方
dialogue.hanzi: 那你先休息一下,以後身體才不會出問題。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ xiān xiūxí yíxià, yǐhòu shēntǐ cái bú huì chū wèntí.
dialogue.gloss: Then rest a bit first, so your health won't have problems later.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 好,你的話使我感覺好多了,謝謝你。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, nǐ de huà shǐ wǒ gǎnjué hǎo duō le, xièxie nǐ.
dialogue.gloss: Okay, your words make me feel much better. Thank you.

sentences.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ xiǎng kāi yì jiā kāfēi diàn.
sentences.gloss: In the future I want to open a coffee shop.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yāoqiú wǒmen zǎo yìdiǎn dào.
sentences.gloss: The boss requires us to arrive a bit earlier.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jīhuì shì biéren gěi wǒ de.
sentences.gloss: This opportunity was given to me by someone else.
